strata_definition: sequence | anatomical side | existing QC label | existing triangulation-reprojection bin | temporal position bin
selection_rule: round-robin over strata, preferring the least-used physical camera among the next six candidates
target_independence: no calibration result, focal error or solver output took any part in the selection
audit_reprojection: the magenta overlay uses provided camera parameters and is AUDIT VISUALISATION ONLY; never an input to the CAM-006 focal solver
